## Checks
- [ ] `ruff`, `mypy`, `pytest` pass locally (or CI is green)
- [ ] New/changed behaviour has tests; nothing is described as measured unless it was measured
- [ ] Migrations are backward compatible (expand/contract) and reversible
- [ ] No secrets, keys or real hostnames committed
- [ ] Docs updated (and README status table if a capability changed)
